description: Sri Lanka Police - The Prevention of Terrorism (Temporary Provisions) Act No. 48 of 1979 - Place of detention of Counter Terrorism Investigation Unit
reasoning: This gazette notification is a legal/regulatory matter. It is a formal notification issued under Section 9 of the Prevention of Terrorism (Temporary Provisions) Act, No. 48 OF 1979, designating a specific location as a place of detention. While it is signed by the President, the core content is the declaration of a legal/statutory instrument, not a government personnel or structural change. It fits the definition of Type 5, which includes "Legal notices and statutory declarations" and "Regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements."
